evidence.text: Kia Corp. said Sunday its domestic sales of electrified vehicles surpassed 300,000 units this year as of Nov. 9, making it the first automaker to reach the milestone in South Korea in a single year. Kia, an automaking affiliate of Hyundai Motor Group, said its sales of electrified vehicles, including electric vehicles and hybrid models, came to 300,048 units, up 41.9 percent from a year earlier.
evidence.title: Kia's domestic electrified vehicle sales top 300,000 units in 2026
